intent.instructions: state.snippet is Vietnamese or English text from a blog post. The marker ⟦NBSP⟧ marks one non-breaking space character in the HTML. A non-breaking space stops the browser from breaking the line at that point. Decide whether the writer needed that effect at the marked position.

criteria.keep_together: The two sides must stay on one line: a number and its unit or currency (10 %, 500 000 đ, 3 GB), a date or time part, an initial and a name, a model or version number, or a symbol that must not start a new line.
criteria.plain_space: The marked character separates two ordinary words or follows punctuation, so a normal space works the same. This is common when text was pasted from Google Docs or Word.
criteria.unknown: The snippet does not show which case applies.
